project_name: EASA Part-66 AI Study Assistant (Module 3 Electrical Fundamentals)
design_archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Avionics Instrument

theme_strategy.rationale: Aviation maintenance and engineering tools demand high legibility, low cognitive fatigue, and cockpit-instrument precision. Deep slate backgrounds (#0B0F17) with glowing amber/cyan telemetry indicators evoke professional avionics flight decks while highlighting source citations and mistake analytics.

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

colors.contrast_rules: Ensure all text on dark slate surfaces achieves minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Never use transparent headers without backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/90).

visual_enhancers.status_badges: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium border

grids_and_layouts.question_navigator: grid grid-cols-8 gap-2 max-h-[300px] overflow-y-auto p-3 bg-slate-950/50 rounded-lg border border-slate-800

instructions_to_main_agent.core_architecture: Build a responsive React (.js) application with modular tabs/views: Dashboard, AI Tutor, Question Bank, Practice Mode, Mock Exam, Mistake Bank, 20-Day Plan, and Admin Portal.
instructions_to_main_agent.source_grounding_feature: Every AI response and Practice/Mock explanation MUST feature an explicit 'SOURCE' button. Clicking opens a drawer showing page image snippet, module 3 submodule name, document title, section heading, and page number.
instructions_to_main_agent.exam_timer_and_rules: Mock exam must strictly enforce 52 questions in 65 minutes with 75% pass mark threshold (39/52), 3 alternatives (A/B/C) per question, real-time question navigator grid, and detailed post-test analytical breakdown by submodule & Level 1/Level 2.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_console: Include JWT admin authentication modal/page, Knowledge-Base ingestion status, First-run processing report with 6 validation checks, Full distribution tables, and Module activation toggles.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_ids: Ensure data-testid attributes are present on key inputs, nav links, source buttons, option choices (data-testid='option-a'), submit buttons, and filter select elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid on interactive elements for automated verification.
Maintain high contrast dark slate theme by default with clean borders (border-slate-800).
Never rely on transparent dropdowns or ungrounded modal overlays.
Use JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono for all formulas, electrical units (V, A, Ohms, Farads, Hz), and citation codes.
Ensure responsive layout works seamlessly from mobile (375px) to ultra-wide displays.
